A '''Human''' [[Gender/Legends|male]], considered by some to be a [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]], lost his [[Unidentified starship (Human)|starship]] to an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and a [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] in a [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] game. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] male was used as an example of the Human [[Species/Legends|species]] in a collection of information about varying [[Sentience/Legends|species]], [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], which was based on research done by former [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], thought of by some to be a [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]],<ref name="LEG">{{SWMiniCite|set=Legacy of the Force|pack=Human Scout}}</ref> played [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] against an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and a [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]]. The Human lost his [[Unidentified starship (Human)|starship]] to the Ithorian in the holochess game.<ref name="TEA" /> The Human was pictured as an example of the Human [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], a collection of information about species based on research performed by retired [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="TNEGTAS" />

==Personality and traits==
The Human had the ability to verse other individuals in holochess, but he was not able to defeat the Ithorian in their holochess match. He also owned a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] at the time of the match.<ref name="TEA" /> On some occasions, the Human wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] [[shirt]], brown pants, black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and an orange-and-white coat. He would also on occasion carry a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="TNEGTAS" /> He had fair skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="TEA" /> and stood around two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="TNEGTAS" /> The Human was considered by some to be a scoundrel.<ref name="LEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Human_Scoundrel_Miniature.jpg|thumb|left|200px|"Human Scoundrel" miniature]]
The Human was first pictured in the "Human" section of the [[2006]] book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''.<ref name="TNEGTAS" /> In [[2008]], ''[[Legacy of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|Star Wars Miniatures: Legacy of the Force]]'' was released, and it contained this Human as a miniature called "Human Scoundrel."<ref name="LEG" /> He was also later included in a picture drawn by [[Chris Trevas]] for the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Human in this picture is, in fact, a self-portrait of Trevas. The editor of ''The Essential Atlas'', [[Erich Schoeneweiss]], came up with the idea of having the Human lose his starship as a joke on Trevas.<ref name="Cite">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_28.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 4 of 5)}}</ref> The image in ''The Essential Atlas'' was used to illustrate the varying [[Realspace/Legends|spacefaring]] species.<ref name="TEA" />
